review_text: A verdict: PASS for bounded behavior: native Store guest side panel visibly labels guest, answers the public demo's stages and Understand result, then answers a same-chat follow-up; replies completed, composer returned to Send, no visible error. Screenshot is direct evidence; report/journal corroborate it.

A limit: Native screenshot/report show Chrome Store source, v0.2.205 and extension ID, but not loaded bundle bytes or a runtime SHA; release receipt maps 0.2.205 to source 2f68bc4, not installed-byte attestation.

Cross-check: hosted run 39283778031 is a separate adapted published-CRX test (CRX digest verified; runtime tree hash recorded), not live Web Store installation. Its native artifact supports three visible terminal answers across opening, same-conversation, and post-reload turns; protocol terminal markers alone do not prove UI completion, but captured answer screenshots do.

The hosted workflow remains pending/in_progress in supplied evidence, with child failure at Values Escape (visible popover remained open after trusted Escape); therefore that run's overall Guest Chat acceptance failed, notwithstanding the bounded answer proof.
Server SHA b8092f2 matched owner pre-observation 16:24:32 and two native post-observations; hosted before/after also match. Observers differ; no inference beyond sampled stability.

B verdict: PASS for evidence traceability/privacy with material limits. Native release receipt links approved source SHA to version/Store ID; that record does not attest loaded bytes. Hosted artifact SHA matches GitHub artifact digest and reports CRX SHA/tree SHA; provenance explicitly says extracted approved CRX loaded in isolated profile, not live Store install.

Website admin indicators are not extension identity: native screenshot and direct report show extension guest banner. Hosted artifact also records fresh guest profile and no login/paywall/error; do not use website auth to infer extension mode.

Sanitized repo evidence omits raw replies, nonce, auth, screenshot contents; raw hosted artifact remains in private /tmp bundle. Guest resource journal sanitization omitted 14 process-attribution records; remaining journal validates one final child_failed decision. Package/browser journals valid; native journal valid exit 0.

Bounded credible claim: on 2026-10-19, tested Store-installed v0.2.205 in a guest session completed one grounded public-demo reply and a same-conversation follow-up with no visible chat error. Separately, the published CRX in an isolated hosted profile produced three grounded terminal replies, while its workflow failed Values Escape and other reviewer checks.

Do not claim broad guest acceptance, settings/capture/SEO/data success, a passing hosted workflow, native installed-byte provenance, runtime SHA for the Store install, current-version/555 behavior, or release readiness.
